root = Stack([header, callout, charts], "column", "m")
header = TextContent("Checkout Page Variants Comparison", "large-heavy")
callout = Callout("success", "Recommendation: Ship Variant D", "Variant D (Express pay first) drove the highest conversion rate (3.9%) and lowest bounce rate (35%), maximizing overall completed checkouts despite a slightly lower AOV.")
charts = Stack([convCard, aovCard, bounceCard], "row", "m", "stretch", "start", true)
convCard = Card([convHeader, convChart])
convHeader = CardHeader("Conversion Rate (%)", "Higher is better")
convChart = BarChart(variants, [convSeries], "grouped")
aovCard = Card([aovHeader, aovChart])
aovHeader = CardHeader("Average Order Value ($)", "Higher is better")
aovChart = BarChart(variants, [aovSeries], "grouped")
bounceCard = Card([bounceHeader, bounceChart])
bounceHeader = CardHeader("Bounce Rate (%)", "Lower is better")
bounceChart = BarChart(variants, [bounceSeries], "grouped")
variants = ["A (Control)", "B (One-page)", "C (Trust)", "D (Express)"]
convSeries = Series("Conversion (%)", [3.1, 3.6, 3.3, 3.9])
aovSeries = Series("AOV ($)", [54, 51, 56, 49])
bounceSeries = Series("Bounce Rate (%)", [41, 37, 40, 35])
